name: Variables
description: Declaration, naming rules, and storage allocation for named memory locations.

name: Data Types
description: Primitive types (int, float, char, double) and their sizes, signed vs unsigned representation.

name: Constants
description: const qualifier, literal constants, and #define macros.

name: Input/Output
description: Standard I/O functions printf, scanf, format specifiers and input buffering.

name: Arithmetic Operators
description: Binary and unary arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /, %, ++, --) and integer division behavior.

name: Relational Operators
description: Comparison operators (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=) producing 0 or 1 integer truth values.

name: Logical Operators
description: Boolean evaluation (&&, ||, !) and short-circuit evaluation semantics.

name: Bitwise Operators
description: Bit-level manipulation (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>) and mask operations.

name: if / else
description: Conditional branching, nested if statements, and dangling else conditions.

name: switch / case
description: Multi-way integer dispatch, case matching, break statements, and fallthrough.

name: for Loops
description: Count-controlled iteration: init, condition, update, and loop invariants.

name: while Loops
description: Pre-test condition loops, loop termination, and infinite loop prevention.

name: do / while
description: Post-test condition loops guaranteeing at least one execution iteration.

name: Function Parameters
description: Function signatures, formal vs actual parameters, and pass-by-value evaluation.

name: Return Values
description: Returning values from functions, void returns, and return statement control transfer.

name: Variable Scope
description: Local, global, and block scopes, variable lifetime, and variable shadowing.

name: Recursion
description: Self-referential functions, base case identification, and call stack unwinding.

name: 1D Arrays
description: Contiguous memory sequence of homogeneous elements, zero-based indexing, and bounds.

name: Array Traversal
description: Iterating over array indices with loops, boundary checking, and element modification.

name: 2D Arrays
description: Row-major multidimensional contiguous allocation and nested loop indexing.

name: Character Arrays
description: char arrays terminated by null terminator '\0', string literals vs mutable arrays.

name: String Functions
description: Standard library string utilities (strlen, strcpy, strcmp, strcat) and buffer bounds.

name: String Manipulation
description: Manual string iteration, reverse, tokenization, and avoiding off-by-one terminator bugs.

name: Memory Addresses
description: Physical/virtual memory layout, byte addressing, byte offsets, and hex address notation.

name: Address Operator &
description: Extracting the lvalue memory location with & operator and assigning to pointer variable.

name: Dereferencing *
description: Accessing and mutating value located at address held by pointer using indirection *.

name: Pointer Arithmetic
description: Adding/subtracting integers to pointers scaled by sizeof(type), pointer subtraction.

name: Arrays and Pointers
description: Array name decay to pointer to first element, *(arr + i) equivalence to arr[i].

name: Structure Definition
description: Grouping heterogeneous types with struct keyword and memory layout / padding.

name: Structure Members
description: Accessing structure fields via dot operator (.), assigning and passing struct values.

name: Structures and Pointers
description: Pointers to structs, arrow operator (->) syntax, dynamic struct allocation.
